findings.title: Debug Mode Active in Production Manifest
findings.desc: Enabling debuggable allows external tools to attach to the application process, run arbitrary code, and read memory states.

findings.title: Application Backup Configuration Weakness
findings.desc: Allows sandbox data extraction via ADB backup command. Physical access or malware can copy application state.

findings.title: Cleartext Network Transport Enabled
findings.desc: Allows HTTP cleartext communication, exposing application API traffic to passive interception.
